reviews.title: Best LCD AIO
reviews.comment: The NZXT Kraken Elite screen is way bigger than I thought. I owned a previous kraken and this dwarves it by a lot. I keep it as a clock and it looks stunning behind my tinted glass. Best of all it keeps thr Ryzen 9 9950x3d super cool despite only being a 240mm radiator

reviews.author: KylerG

reviews.title: NZXT Kraken Elite RGB 240mm – THIS THING IS INSANE
reviews.comment:
Okay, I have to say it — this cooler is an absolute beast.  Installation was stupid easy, the fans look SICK, and the cooling performance is next-level. My CPU temps dropped way more than I expected, even while gaming and pushing my rig hard. And it’s SILENT. Like, I had to double-check if the fans were even running lol.

The 2.72" 60FPS display? GAME-CHANGER. Smooth, bright, and you can slap your favorite gifs or system stats on it — looks so clean it’s unreal. NZXT really killed it with this one.

If you’re even thinking about upgrading, just do it. Totally worth it. 10/10, no notes.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: Premium AIO for any build
reviews.comment: Bought this for my new PC build and it really completes the look. It keeps my 7800x3D under 70° on quiet preset and unless you crank up the fans super high you cant even hear it. Being able to put GIFs on it too is awesome! NZXT’s CAM really makes it easy to customize and set the AIO to how you need it to perform.
reviews.author: Reece
